title: Effect of oxygen concentration, pressure, and opposed flow velocity on the flame spread along thin PMMA sheets

source.rights: Article states CC BY on page 1; source PDF is not redistributed here.
source.extraction: Printed matrix symbols and method text; no plotted measurements digitized.

measurementOperator.quantity: Pyrolysis-front propagation rate, not visible flame-boundary velocity
measurementOperator.scanDirection: From the side facing away from the igniter
measurementOperator.estimator: Linear regression of the mean front position across the 11 lines

scope.coordinateMeaning: Reported nominal oxygen volume percent, pressure in kPa and inflow in mm/s; actual coordinate uncertainty is not available.
scope.flowMeasurement: Calculated from metered gas mass flows, pressure and channel cross section; not a direct local velocity measurement (page 2).
scope.replication: Section 2.2 generally reports one experiment per parameter. Error bars describe within-experiment deviations; multiple runs, where present, are shown separately.
scope.excluded: 1g experiments: natural convection, with 200 mm/s assumed in Figure 10. These are not additional prescribed-flow microgravity observations.

tableOFlowSweep.locator: PDF/printed page 4, Table 1, O cell and section 2.2

design.tableLocator: PDF/printed page 4, Table 1; X denotes 100 mm/s, O denotes the 30-200 mm/s flow sweep
design.supportStatement: Section 2.2 restricts the flow sweep to 35.4% oxygen at 60 kPa; other microgravity tests use 100 mm/s.
design.outerSupport: Within the reported marginal ranges: u=100 OR (x=35.4 AND p=60). This contains the reported nominal design; it is not a filled measurement surface.

conflicts.description: Table 1 prints several oxygen-series X cells under 70 kPa; Figure 6 describes a 75 kPa oxygen series. Figure 3 describes 35.4% oxygen at 75 kPa, a condition not listed as X in Table 1.
locators: PDF/printed page 4, Table 1 and Figure 6 caption
conflicts.policy: Preserve Table 1 exactly. Do not replace 70 with 75, manufacture runs or assert that an unlisted point was never measured.
conflicts.reason: Both pressure readings remain on the u=100 plane; the certificate depends on section 2.2, not a corrected pressure matrix.
